title: [CoreTweaker127][CrazyMod]Digging dirt drops artifacts挖泥土掉神器
description: 泥土是一件很没有用的物品，来试试这款模组！我们让泥土变得更加有用，挖掘泥土可以掉落神级装备，快来试试吧！Dirt is a very useless item, try this mod! We make dirt more useful; digging dirt can drop god-tier equipment. Come and give it a try!
body:
这里推荐一个非常强力的整合包，可以大幅提升帧率和内存利用效率，推荐大家去试试Here's a super powerful pack I recommend—it can greatly boost frame rates and memory efficiency. You should definitely give it a try.：https://modrinth.com/modpack/fps--optimization
模组拥有完全不同的玩法机制与创意方向。无论你选择哪一个版本，都能体验到独特的游戏风格。本模组对 Minecraft 本体的稳定性影响极小，不会修改核心系统，适合在各种环境中轻量使用。 反馈与建议
如果你在游玩过程中产生了新的想法、创意或改进建议，欢迎前往 GitHub 提交 Issue 或反馈意见。你的建议将直接影响未来版本的设计方向，帮助模组持续成长。 版本说明：v1.0.0 – v1.0.0.1
挖掘泥土会掉落高强度 OP 装备与稀有物品，提供极具爽感的快速成长体验。（如255级附魔下界合金装备，255级的剑，斧子，稿子，不死图腾，传送门框架）下载后可以更好地利用泥土，更快地让装备变好。注意：在进行世界记录挑战或速通时一定不要使用此模组，以免被封号
The mod features entirely different gameplay mechanics and creative directions. No matter which version you choose, you can experience a unique game style. This mod has minimal impact on the stability of the Minecraft base game and does not modify core systems, making it suitable for lightweight use in various environments.  Feedback and Suggestions
If you come up with new ideas, creativity, or improvement suggestions while playing, feel free to submit an Issue or provide feedback on GitHub. Your suggestions will directly influence the design direction of future versions and help the mod continue to grow.  Version Notes: v1.0.0 – v1.0.0.1
Digging dirt will drop high-strength OP equipment and rare items, providing a highly satisfying rapid growth experience. (For example, level 255 enchanted Netherite gear, level 255 swords, axes, pickaxes, Totems of Undying, portal frames) After downloading, you can make better use of dirt to upgrade your equipment more quickly. Note: Do not use this mod when attempting world record challenges or speedruns, to avoid being banned.
